title: Repeated System Failures and the Systems Settlement — Calloway Limited Home Warranty Claims Guidance
content:
**Guidance.** How the systems settlement under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty is taken from the scheduled systems settlement follows the accepted callbacks approved on the coverage under systems coverage within the last 12 calendar months (dated later than the same calendar day 12 months before the settlement date), which are the systems approvals of that window that are not original approvals: with two or more such callbacks the systems settlement is the program's cash-in-lieu maximum itself, because the system has failed repeatedly; with exactly one such callback it is the scheduled systems settlement plus half of the difference between the program's cash-in-lieu maximum and the scheduled systems settlement, rounded to the nearest cent; with no such callback it is the scheduled systems settlement.

An approval is an original approval when it is the item's first decision; an approval of a reopened callback carries callback sequence 1 or higher and is counted here.

## Worked cases (hypothetical cash-in-lieu maximum USD 1500.00, scheduled systems settlement USD 792.00)

| Systems approvals in the window | Of which original approvals | Accepted callbacks counted | Systems settlement |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 | 0 | USD 792.00 |
| 2 | 1 | 1 | 792.00 plus half of 708.00, which is USD 1146.00 |
| 3 | 1 | 2 | USD 1500.00 |

**Window edge.** Settled on 15 October 2025, a callback approval dated 16 October 2024 is counted and one dated 15 October 2024 is not.
